```{r}
  Rar = FALSE,
  Marker = "ITS")

g_its <- import_genet(config)$motus %>%

length(morpho)
```

### Markers coverage : Family, Genus, Species

```{r}

# ---- Datasets ----

config_tab <- expand.grid(
  "Marker" = c("Bota","GH","ITS","18S","REF"),
  "Level" = c("Family","Genus","Species"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ---- Fill Community Composition ----

for(i in 1:nrow(config_tab)){
  
  print(i)
  L <- config_tab[i,]$Level
  M <- config_tab[i,]$Marker
  
  if(M == "Bota"){
    df <- import_bota(list("Year" = 2012))
    config_tab$Ab_tib[[i]] <- rank_ab_tib_bota(df, L)
  }
  else if(M %in% c("GH","ITS","18S")){
    df <- import_genet(list("Marker" = config_tab[i,]$Marker,"Rar" = TRUE))
    config_tab$Ab_tib[[i]] <- rank_ab_tib_genet(df, tolower(L))
  }
  else if(M %in% c("REF")){
    config_tab$Ab_tib[[i]] <- import_plants_nouragues() %>%
      pull(.data[[tolower(L)]]) %>%
      unique()
  }
}

# 3 plots
levels <- unique(config_tab$Level)

list_by_level <- lapply(levels, function(lvl){
  
  sub_tab <- config_tab[config_tab$Level == lvl, ]
  
  # créer une liste nommée avec les markers
  listes <- setNames(sub_tab$Ab_tib, sub_tab$Marker)
  
  return(listes)
})

names(list_by_level) <- levels

extract_names <- function(df){
  if("Family" %in% names(df)) return(df$Family)
  if("family" %in% names(df)) return(df$family)
  if("Genus" %in% names(df)) return(df$Genus)
  if("genus" %in% names(df)) return(df$genus)
  if("Species" %in% names(df)) return(df$Species)
  if("species" %in% names(df)) return(df$species)
  return(df)
}

list_by_level_clean <- lapply(list_by_level, function(level_list){
  
  lapply(level_list, function(df){
    x <- extract_names(df)
    
    # enlever NA et doublons
    x <- unique(na.omit(x))
    
    return(x)
  })
})


# ---- Plots ----

library(UpSetR)

set_size <- list("Family"=200, "Genus"=600, "Species"=1600)

plot_list <- lapply(names(list_by_level_clean), function(lvl){
  data_upset <- fromList(list_by_level_clean[[lvl]])
  
  upset(data_upset,
        nsets = ncol(data_upset),
        order.by = "freq",
        show.numbers = "yes",
        set_size.show = TRUE,
        main.bar.color = "steelblue",
        sets.bar.color = "gray",
        mainbar.y.label = paste("Intersections -", lvl),
        sets.x.label = "Set Size",
        set_size.scale_max = set_size[[lvl]])
})


```

# 1. Patch
## Grid Bota (all Metric)

```{r}
# Config
basic_config <- list(
  Level = "Family",
  Name = "Fabaceae",
  Type = "bota",
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = 10)

# No filters
grid_filters <- list()

# All metric
all_metrics <- c("Count","NCI","Basal_Area_m2","OTU","Shannon","H1")

# All plots
all_plots <- list()

for (m in all_metrics) {
  grid_config <- basic_config
  grid_config$Metric <- m
  
  # Grid Read
  grid <- grid_read(
    config = grid_config,
    filters = grid_filters
  )
  
  # Plot
  all_plots[[m]] <- plot_grid(grid)
  
}

Wrap <- wrap_plots(all_plots, ncol = 3) + 
  plot_annotation(
    title = paste0("Toutes les Metrics pour l'inventaire :  ", 
                   basic_config$Type, " / ", 
                   basic_config$Level, " / ", 
                   basic_config$Name, " / R = ", 
                   basic_config$Radius
                   )
    )


```

## Abiotic Pannel

```{r}

# Import
abiotic <- import_abiotic() %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(x,y))

# Abiotic variables
abiotic_vars <- colnames(abiotic) 

# Plot list
plot_list <- list()

# Plot loop
for(i in 1:length(abiotic_vars)){
  
  # Metric
  metric <- abiotic_vars[[i]]
  print(metric)
  
  # Config
  config <- list(
    Type = "abiotic",
    Metric = metric)
  
  # Grid
  grid <- grid_read(config)
  
  # Plot
  plot_list[[i]] <- plot_grid(grid) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(caption = grid$config$Name) +
    theme(
      plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,   # centré
        size = 9,
        face = "bold.italic"
      )
    )
  
}

wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 10)
```

```{r}

# Configurations
bota_conf <- expand.grid(
  Type = "bota",

  Name = "Goupia glabra",

  Year = "2012",

  Type = "bota",
  Level = "Species",

  Metric = c("NCI"),
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = 20,
  Alpha = 1.5,
  Beta = 0.1)

  Type = "genet",
  Level = "Species",
  Name = "Goupia glabra",
  Metric = "Reads",
  Rar = TRUE,
  Marker = c("GH"))

config_tab <- bind_rows(list(bota_conf, nci_conf, genet_conf))

# Generate grids
grid_list <- build_grids(config_tab)

titles <- list(
  "Presence / Absence",
  "Count (R=20)",
  expression(bold(NCI~"("~alpha==1.5*","~beta==0.1~")")),
  "GH Reads"
)

# Generate plots
plot_list <- Map(function(grid, title){
  plot_grid(grid, stems = TRUE) +
    labs(title = title)

# Wrap
wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 4)
```

## 2. Rank correspondance

```{r}
# Tests statistiques :

# 1. “Est-ce que les rangs sont respectés entre inventaires ?”
# Kendall's tau
# cor.test(rank_inv1, rank_inv2, method = "kendall")
# library(irr)
# kendall(matrix_des_rangs)

# 2. “Est-ce que le génétique amplifie la dominance ?”
# Régression
# lm(log(abond_genetique) ~ log(abond_botanique))
# 🔍 Interprétation
# pente = 1 → pas de changement de structure
# pente > 1 → amplification des dominantes
# pente < 1 → atténuation

# Bota
bota <- import_bota(list("Year" = 2012))
Ab_bota <- rank_ab_tib_bota_BA(bota, "Family")

# GH
metabarlist <- import_genet(
  list(
    "Marker" = "GH",
    "Rar" = TRUE
  ))
Ab_GH <- rank_ab_tib_genet(metabarlist, "family") %>%
  dplyr::rename(Family = family)

# ITS
metabarlist <- import_genet(
  list(
    "Marker" = "ITS",
    "Rar" = TRUE
  ))
Ab_ITS <- rank_ab_tib_genet(metabarlist, "family") %>%
  dplyr::rename(Family = family)

# JOIN
plot_log_log <- function(Ab1, Ab2, marker){
  Ab_join_GH <- inner_join(Ab1, Ab2, by = "Family")
  
  library(ggpubr)

  ggplot(Ab_join_GH, aes(x = log(Abundance), y = log(Reads))) +
    theme_light() +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    coord_fixed() +
    xlim(0, 15) +
    ylim(0, 15) +
    stat_cor(method = "spearman", label.x = 1, label.y = 14) +
    labs(title = paste0(marker, " ~ Bota")) +
    xlab("log(Basal Area)")+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16))
}


p1 <- plot_log_log(Ab_bota, Ab_GH, "GH")
p2 <- plot_log_log(Ab_bota, Ab_ITS, "ITS")
p1 | p2

```


## 3. Growth Types

```{r}
growth <- import_plants_nouragues()

# General table
tab_all_growth <- growth %>%
    summarise(across(starts_with("stat."), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    mutate(across(starts_with("stat."), ~ round(.x / rowSums(across(starts_with("stat."))) * 100, digits = 2))) %>%
    rename_with(~ sub("^stat\\.", "", .x), starts_with("stat.")) %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  arrange(desc(V1))

view(tab_all_growth)

# By family
tab_family_growth <- growth %>%
  group_by(family) %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with("stat."), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    mutate(across(starts_with("stat."), ~ .x / rowSums(across(starts_with("stat."))) * 100)) %>%
    rename_with(~ sub("^stat\\.", "", .x), starts_with("stat.")) 

view(tab_family_growth)

# Nourague reference for families %
tab_family_ref <- growth %>%
  group_by(family) %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with("stat."), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))%>%
  mutate(
    total = rowSums(across(starts_with("stat.")), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(family,total) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    total = (total / sum(total)) * 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total))

view(tab_family_ref)

```

### B.1 Table Annexe

```{r}

# Copy
df_reduced <- df_ab_rel_Richness

# Annotate
df_reduced$Result <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df_reduced)), function(i) {
    df_reduced$Result[[i]] %>% 
    mutate(Metric = round(Metric, digits = 2)) %>%
    mutate( `<2%` = ifelse(Metric < 2 ,TRUE ,FALSE)) %>%
    mutate( `<0.05%` = ifelse(Metric < 0.05 ,TRUE ,FALSE))
  })

# Classify
source_names <- c( "GH","GH", "ITS","ITS", "18S","18S", "Bota")

df_list <- lapply(1:7, function(i) {
  
  # Select
  df <- df_reduced$Result[[i]]
  
  # Ajouter la colonne Source
  df$Source <- source_names[i]
  
  return(df)
})

# Combine
df_plot_rar <-  bind_rows(df_list[c(2,4,6,7)]) %>%
  mutate( in_bota = Clade %in% df_list[7][[1]]$Clade) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!Metric < 0.5)

# Plot
ab_rel_tab(df_plot_rar)

```


### B.2 Replace \< 2% families

```{r}

df_reduced <- df_ab_rel_Richness

df_reduced$Result <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df_reduced)), function(i) {
    df_reduced$Result[[i]] %>% percent_other("Clade", "Metric", 2)
  })


# Liste des indices correspondant aux différentes sources
source_indices <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7)
source_names <- c( "GH","GH", "ITS","ITS", "18S","18S", "Bota")

# Appliquer une fonction à chaque élément de la liste df_reduced$Result
df_list <- lapply(seq_along(source_indices), function(i) {
  # Extraire le dataframe correspondant
  df_temp <- df_reduced$Result[[source_indices[i]]]
  
  # Ajouter la colonne Source
  df_temp$Source <- source_names[i]
  
  return(df_temp)
})

```

### D. Linear model BA / OTU

```{r}


# List of dataframes
dfs <- list(
  OTU    = df_ab_rel_Richness$Result[[7]],
  BA  = df_ab_rel_Richness$Result[[9]]
)

# Combine dataframes
compare <- dfs %>%
  imap(~ rename(.x, !!.y := Metric)) %>%   # renomme Metric avec le nom de la liste
  reduce(inner_join, by = "Clade")     # inner join

# Plot
ggplot(compare, aes(x = OTU, y = BA)) +
  geom_point() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_light() +
```

```{r}
  group_by(family) %>%

  group_by(family) %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with("stat."), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))%>%
```

```{r}
library(randomForest)

# Random forest function
rand_for_IncMSE <- function(data_pixel){
  
  set.seed(123) # For reproductibility
  
  rf_model <- randomForest(
    Metric ~ .,              # toutes les variables explicatives
    data = data_pixel %>% dplyr::select(-x, -y, -sample_loc),  # enlever coordonnées si non pertinentes
    ntree = 500,
    importance = TRUE
  )
  
  # # importance des variables
  # importance(rf_model)
  # varImpPlot(rf_model)
  
  # Plot
  var_imp <- as.data.frame(importance(rf_model))
  var_imp$Variable <- rownames(var_imp)
  
  p <- ggplot(var_imp, aes(x = reorder(Variable, `%IncMSE`), y = `%IncMSE`)) +
    geom_col(fill = "grey") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_light() +
    #scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 20)) + # Homogène scaling
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0,size = 14, face="bold"),
      axis.text.y.left = element_text(face="bold")
    )
  
  return(list(p, rf_model, data_pixel))
}
```

## XXX. Diversity distance-decay (Irène)


```{r}

divLeinster <- function(q=2 ,spxp , Z=NULL,  check = TRUE){
  #Calcul the diversity of each site of sites by species matrix. 
  #spxp columns and Z rows and columns are assumed to be in the same order.

  if (is.null(Z)) Z <- diag(ncol(spxp))
  if (check){
    if (!inherits(spxp, "matrix")) {
      stop("object \"spxp\" is not of class \"matrix\"")}  
    if (!inherits(Z, "matrix")) {
      stop("object \"Z\" is not of class \"matrix\"")}  
    if (!all(c(ncol(Z), nrow(Z)) == ncol(spxp))){
      stop("object \"Z\" and object \"spxp\" does not have matching dimensions")}
  }  

  spxp <- sweep(spxp, 1, rowSums(spxp), "/")
  Zp <- Z %*% t(spxp)

  if (q != 1 & q != Inf){
    mat <- t(spxp) * (Zp)^(q-1)
    mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
    D <- colSums(mat) ^ (1/(1-q))
  }

  if (q==Inf)  {
    D <- 1/ apply(Zp, 2, max)
  }  

  if (q == 1){
    D <- apply(Zp^t(spxp), 2, function(x) 1/prod(x))
  }

  return(D)
}


abgDecompQ <- function(spxp, Z=NULL, q=2, check=TRUE) {
  #Calcul the diversity of each site of sites by species matrix. 
  #spxp columns and Z rows/cols are assumed to be in the same order.

  if (is.null(Z)) Z <- diag(ncol(spxp))
  if (check){
    if (!inherits(spxp, "matrix")) {
      stop("object \"spxp\" is not of class \"matrix\"")}  
    if (!inherits(Z, "matrix")) {
      stop("object \"Z\" is not of class \"matrix\"")}  
    if (!all(c(ncol(Z), nrow(Z)) == ncol(spxp))){
      stop("object \"Z\" and object \"spxp\" does not have matching dimensions")}
  }

  site.weight <- rep(1/nrow(spxp), nrow(spxp))
  spxp <- sweep(spxp, 1, rowSums(spxp), "/")

  gamma.ab <- colSums(sweep(spxp, 1, site.weight, "*"))

  Gamma <- divLeinster(t(as.matrix(gamma.ab)), Z=Z , q=q, check = FALSE)
  Alphas <- divLeinster(spxp, Z=Z , q=q, check = FALSE) 

  if (q != 1 & q != Inf) {
    mAlpha <- (sum(site.weight * (Alphas ^ (1 - q))))^(1 / (1 - q))
  }

  if (q==1){
    mAlpha <- exp(sum(site.weight * log(Alphas)))
  }

  if (q==Inf){
    mAlpha <- min(Alphas)
  }

  Beta <- Gamma / mAlpha

  names(Alphas) <- row.names(spxp)
  res <- list(Gamma=Gamma, Beta=Beta, mAlpha=mAlpha, Alphas=Alphas)

  return(res)
}

BetaDisQ <- function(q=2,spxp, Z=NULL, check = TRUE){
  #Calcul the site pairwise diversity of a sites by species matrix. 
  #spxp columns and Z rows/cols are assumed to be in the same order.
  # this function uses the Jaccard‐type overlap (UqN) as a measure of similarity

  N <- nrow(spxp)
  dis <- matrix(NA, N, N)
  
  for (i in 2:N) {
    for (j in 1:(i-1)) {
      spxp.dummy <- spxp[c(i,j), ]
      res <- abgDecompQ(as.matrix(spxp.dummy), Z = NULL, q = q, check = FALSE)
      dis[i, j] <- dis[j, i] <- res$Beta
    }
  }

  diag(dis) <- 1
  dis <- dis - 1
  row.names(dis) <- colnames(dis) <- row.names(spxp)

  return(dis)
}
```

## XXX. Diversity profiles

```{r}

library("entropart")

# GENET
rank_ab_tib_genet <- function(df, Level){
  
  Reads <- colSums(df$reads)
  as.data.frame(Reads) -> Reads
  Reads$id <- row.names(Reads)
  
  Ab_tib <- left_join(df$motus, Reads, by = "id") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[Level]])) %>%
    group_by(.data[[Level]]) %>%
    summarise(Reads = sum(Reads))
  
  Ab_tib %>% 
    arrange(desc(Reads)) %>%
    mutate(Rank = 1:length(Reads))
}

rank_ab_vec_genet <- function(df, Level){
  Ab_tib <- rank_ab_tib_genet(df, Level)

  # Build a named vector
  Ab_vec <- Ab_tib$Reads
  names(Ab_vec) <- Ab_tib[[Level]]
  
  # Vector of abundances
  Ab_vec %>% as.AbdVector()
}

# BOTA

rank_ab_tib_bota <- function(df, Level){
  df %>% 
    group_by(.data[[Level]]) %>% 
    summarize(Abundance = n()) %>%
    arrange(desc(Abundance)) %>%
    mutate(Rank = 1:length(Abundance))
}

rank_ab_vec_bota <- function(df, Level){
  Ab_tib <- rank_ab_tib_bota(df, Level)

  # Build a named vector
  Ab_vec <- Ab_tib$Abundance
  names(Ab_vec) <- Ab_tib[[Level]]
  
  # Vector of abundances
  Ab_vec %>% as.AbdVector() -> Ab_vec
}
```

```{r}
levels <- c("Species", "Genus", "Family")
# Rar
rar <- TRUE 

# Configurations
config_rar <- expand.grid(
  "g.Rar" = rar,
  "g.Marker" = c("GH","ITS","18S"),
  "b.Radius" = 10,
  "b.Year" = c(2012),
  "Metric_corr" = c("F+","F-"),
  "Level" = levels,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Give common Names for each level
level_list <- setNames(
  lapply(levels, function(l) give_common_taxa(Rar = rar, Level = l)),
  levels
)

# Make correlation table
tab_rar <- make_cor_table_bota_genet(config_rar, level_list)

# View
view(tab_rar)
```

## C. Tests Statistiques

### Test : Correlation \~ Metric_corr

```{r}
# ANOVA Test : Count / NCI
res_aov <- aov(Correlation ~ Metric_corr, data = tab_rar[tab_rar$Metric_corr %in% c("Count","NCI","MCC"),])
summary(res_aov)

#              Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)  
# Metric_corr   2   0.14 0.07012    2.35 0.0963 .
# Residuals   555  16.56 0.02983                 
# ---
# Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
# 729 observations effacées parce que manquantes

# Moyenne ajustée
library(emmeans)
emm <- emmeans(res_aov, pairwise ~ Metric_corr)
plot(emm)

# Letters
library(multcompView)
tuk <- TukeyHSD(res_aov)
multcompLetters4(res_aov, tuk)

# a a a

```

```{r}
# ANOVA Test : Species / Genus / Family
res_aov <- aov(Correlation ~ Level, data = tab_rar[tab_rar$Metric_corr %in% c("Count","NCI","MCC"),])
```

# 4. Abiotic Factors


## Reads VS Light

```{r}

# Abiotic
config <- list(
  Type = "abiotic",
  Metric = "light")
  
# Grid
light <- grid_read(config)

# Genet
config <- list(
  Type = "genet",
  Rar = FALSE,
  Marker = "GH",
  Level = "Family",
  Name = "All",
  Metric = "Reads")

# Grid
reads <- grid_read(config)

# Bota
config <- list(
  Level = "Family",
  Name = "All",
  Type = "bota",
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = "pixel",
  Metric = "Basal_Area_m2"
  )

BA <- grid_read(config)

# List of dataframes
dfs <- list(
  light = light$df,
  reads = reads$df,
  BA    = BA$df
)

# Combine dataframes
compare <- dfs %>%
  imap(~ rename(.x, !!.y := Metric)) %>%   # renomme Metric avec le nom de la liste
  reduce(inner_join, by = c("x", "y"))     # inner join

# Plot
ggplot(compare, aes(x = light, y = reads, colour = log(BA+1))) +
  geom_point()

```


```{r}
ggplot(compare, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = log(reads+1))) +
  geom_tile() +
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c()
```


```{r}
library(gstat)
library(sp)

coordinates(compare) <- ~ x + y
v <- variogram(reads ~ 1, compare)
plot(v)
```

```{r}
library(spdep)

coords <- as.matrix(compare[, c("x", "y")])
nb <- spdep::dnearneigh(coords, 0, 1)  # voisins à distance ≤ 1 unité
lw <- spdep::nb2listw(nb, style = "W")
spdep::moran.test(compare$reads, lw)
```

```{r}
# Abiotic
abiotic <- import_abiotic() %>%
  dplyr::select(x,y,light,canop12,topo,wetness,Ca,Al,K,C,N) %>%
  mutate(CNratio = C / N) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(C,N))

# Grid
h1 <- grid_read(list(
  Type = "genet",
  Rar = TRUE,
  Marker = "GH",
  Level = "Family",
  Name = "All",
  Metric = "Shannon"))
h1 <- h1$df


# Combine dataframes
compare <- inner_join(h1,abiotic ,by=c("x", "y")) %>%
  select(-c("x","y","sample_loc"))

# Plot
pairs(compare)

ggplot(compare, aes(x = light, y = Metric, colour = canop12)) +
  geom_point()

library(plotly)

plot_ly(
  data = compare,
  x = ~topo,
  y = ~Metric,
  z = ~wetness,
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(size = 3)
)
```


## Random Forest

```{r}
library(randomForest)

set.seed(123)

abiotic <- import_abiotic()
genet <- reads$df %>% rename(reads = Metric)
data_pixel <- inner_join(genet, abiotic, by = c("x","y"))

rf_model <- randomForest(
  reads ~ .,              # toutes les variables explicatives
  data = data_pixel %>% dplyr::select(-x, -y),  # enlever coordonnées si non pertinentes
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE
)

# importance des variables
importance(rf_model)
varImpPlot(rf_model)

# Plot
library(ggplot2)

var_imp <- as.data.frame(importance(rf_model))
var_imp$Variable <- rownames(var_imp)

ggplot(var_imp, aes(x = reorder(Variable, `%IncMSE`), y = `%IncMSE`)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(y = "%IncMSE", x = "", title = "Importance des variables pour log(reads)")

# Impacte d'une variable :
library(pdp)
partial(rf_model, pred.var = "Cd") %>% plotPartial()

```


### Cross validation par block spatiaux

```{r}

# Creation des blocks spatiaux
library(sf)

# Transformer data_pixel en sf
data_pixel_sf <- st_as_sf(
  data_pixel,
  coords = c("x", "y"),  # colonnes pour les coordonnées
  crs = 4326             # CRS arbitraire, à adapter si nécessaire
)

# Transformer en CRS projecté arbitraire (unités locales)
data_pixel_sf <- st_set_crs(data_pixel_sf, NA) %>%  # retirer CRS actuel
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"))                     # reconvertir en sf POINT

# s'assurer que log_reads existe
data_pixel_sf$log_reads <- log1p(data_pixel_sf$reads)

library(blockCV)

# séparer x et y
x_sf <- data_pixel_sf %>% dplyr::select(-reads, -log_reads)  # sf avec toutes les variables explicatives + geometry
y_var <- data_pixel_sf$log_reads                      # réponse

# lancer la CV spatiale
spatial_cv <- cv_spatial(
  x = x_sf,          # sf avec géométrie
  y = y_var,         # vecteur réponse
  k = 5,             # nombre de folds
  selection = "random",
  theRange = 5 ,      # taille du bloc spatial
  plot = FALSE
)

library(ggplot2)

# extraire x et y depuis geometry
data_pixel_sf <- data_pixel_sf %>%
  mutate(
    x = st_coordinates(.)[,1],  # première colonne = x
    y = st_coordinates(.)[,2]   # deuxième colonne = y
  )

data_pixel_sf$foldID <- spatial_cv$folds_ids

# Verification des blocks spatiaux
ggplot(data_pixel_sf) +
  geom_point(aes(x = x, y = y, color = as.factor(foldID))) +
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  labs(title = "Blocs CV spatiaux", color = "Fold")

# Créer la liste de folds pour caret
folds_list <- lapply(unique(data_pixel_sf$foldID), function(f) {
  which(data_pixel_sf$foldID != f)  # toutes les lignes sauf celles du fold f (train)
})

# Cross validation

library(caret)
library(randomForest)

# transformer sf en data.frame classique (enlever geometry)
data_df <- data_pixel_sf %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(-foldID, -reads)  # foldID est seulement pour CV, pas pour le modèle

# ajouter la variable réponse
data_df$log_reads <- log1p(data_pixel_sf$reads)

# Définir le contrôle de CV pour caret
train_control <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  index = folds_list
)

# Entraîner le modèle Random Forest
rf_cv <- train(
  log_reads ~ .,          # toutes les variables explicatives
  data = data_df,
  method = "rf",
  trControl = train_control,
  ntree = 500
)


# Évaluation des performances
print(rf_cv)
rf_cv$results
rf_cv$finalModel


```
